notes:
Lead source: blog post on 'reranking strategies' (organic inbound). Initial touch: demo request via signup form -> redirected to trial.

Quick summary / context:
- Small legal-tech SaaS (DocRanger) building a contract search product for field teams (paralegals + sales).
- Goal: accurate passage-level answers + high-precision reranking for short queries. They currently use keyword search + basic BM25.
- Interested in Redwood hosted API for embeddings + a lightweight reranker (dense + cross-encoder) to reduce false positives.
- Volume/scale: ~5k-50k documents to start, expect spike to ~200k over 12 months. Typical query size short (1-3 sent), median doc length ~3-5 pages.
- Latency target: 200-400ms p99 for single-step retrieval+rerank (they accept staged approach but want upper bound). Throughput: bursty during business hours, ~40-100 qps peak. Cost sensitive — want to keep monthly hosted costs under ~$2k during POC.

Technical questions raised on call (3/02 FF):
- "Can we point Redwood hosted embeddings at Pinecone/Chroma? We want to keep vector store separate to avoid lock-in."
- Support for batch upsert (they ingest daily PDF batches) and delta updates (doc revisions).
- Reranker options: prefer a hosted cross-encoder that can run as a second-step with prefix/KV cache to reduce recompute.
- Tokenization: concerned about PDF OCR noise and need guidance on chunking strategy for legal docs.
- Security: need SOC2 report + SSO (SAML) for AE/PM access to console. No hard data residency requirement (US-based data ok).

POC plan discussed:
- Week 0: create hosted trial account, ingest 5k sample docs (customer provides sanitized set).
- Week 1: run embedding pipeline (batch), integrate with their Pinecone test instance (or Chroma if preferred).
- Week 2: evaluate candidate rerankers (Redwood-verified models) on 50 sample queries, measure MRR / precision@1 and latency.
- Success criteria: precision@1 > 0.82 on legal QA set and end-to-end p99 < 500ms for common queries.

Notes from AE/SE call (Alex):
- SE recommended chunking 800-1500 token windows with 100 token overlap for contracts; suggested pre-filtering by metadata tags to reduce candidate set.
- Discussed using Redwood prefix caching for common queries (sales contract templates) to lower costs.
- Cost estimate shared: embeddings + rerank for 5k docs ~ $150-$350/month on hosted API depending on model choice.

Quotes / snippets from customer:
- "We need better precision than BM25 — too many irrelevant clauses returned."
- "We like open models but we need an SLA and predictable cost for production."
